test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a spreadsheet program?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ubuntu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ubuntu** is a **Linux-based open-source Operating System.**
 
• It can be used in enterprise servers, desktops, the cloud, and IoT.
 
• **VisiCalc** (visible calculator) is the **first spreadsheet **computer program for personal computers, originally released for **Apple II **by VisiCorp in **1979**. 
 
• **Calc** is a **spreadsheet program** specially used for **heavy scientific and financial operations.**
 
• **Excel **is a** spreadsheet program** of **Microsoft **for Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. It forms part of the Microsoft Office suite of software.
